title: LuckRead D1-03 Entity Owner Boundary
purpose: Partition D1-03 operational authority by existing Worker responsibilities without creating tables, Workers, or any D1 beyond the five-domain target.

AuditEvent.rule: Append-only platform audit records; source Workers emit versioned audit events and do not acquire D1-03 write ownership.

boundaryRules: Domain-local outbox/inbox/idempotency records remain in their source D1 and are not treated as D1-03 entities.
W10 execution authority does not transfer business entity ownership from W06/W09/W11 or any other D1.
D1-03 is not a generic business-data sink.
Every authoritative D1-03 entity has exactly one primary Worker owner.
Cross-owner changes use explicit events/contracts rather than unrestricted direct database access.
W05 is not a general D1-03 owner; its only scoped delegated D1-03 writer exception is NotificationPushEndpoint under T14, with W09 remaining the primary entity owner.

NotificationPushEndpoint.scope: Authenticated self-service registration and deletion for the current user's Expo push endpoint only.
NotificationPushEndpoint.boundary: W05 may write only notification_push_endpoints through the declared D1_03 binding. It gains no other D1-03 entity ownership or platform runtime authority.
